summary: Backend-only testing completed for Custodial Wallet feature. All 24 tests passed - wallet creation/info, deposit address retrieval, deposit validation (max 0.5 SOL limit enforced), withdrawal validation (requires balance), and transaction history endpoints all working correctly.
passed_tests: TestCustodialWalletInfo::test_custodial_wallet_info_structure - PASSED (wallet_address, balance_sol, balance_lamports, max_deposit_sol, available_deposit_sol, created_at, total_deposits, total_withdrawals)
critical_code_review_comments: Custodial wallet router properly registered in server.py at line 135
CUSTODIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY is correctly set in backend/.env for private key encryption
Max deposit limit enforced at 0.5 SOL via Pydantic Field validation (le=MAX_DEPOSIT_SOL)
Private keys are encrypted using Fernet symmetric encryption before storage in MongoDB
Wallet addresses are valid Solana base58-encoded public keys (32-44 characters)
Withdrawal properly validates balance before execution and reserves fee buffer (10000 lamports)
Transaction history endpoint correctly returns 404 for non-existent wallets

verified_api_endpoints.GET /api/custodial-wallet/info/{wallet}: Creates new custodial wallet if not exists, returns wallet info with balance, limits, and stats
verified_api_endpoints.GET /api/custodial-wallet/address/{walle: Returns deposit address with 0.5 SOL limit instruction
verified_api_endpoints.POST /api/custodial-wallet/prepare-depos: Validates deposit amount (0 < amount <= 0.5 SOL), returns deposit instructions
verified_api_endpoints.POST /api/custodial-wallet/withdraw: Validates balance before withdrawal, returns 400 if insufficient (reserves 10000 lamports for fee)
verified_api_endpoints.GET /api/custodial-wallet/transactions/{: Returns transaction history with limit parameter support

security_verification.max_deposit_enforced: 0.5 SOL (via Pydantic validation and balance checks)

seed_data_creation: Multiple test custodial wallets created with TEST_ prefix during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All custodial wallet backend endpoints verified working. Frontend Auto-Trade tab integration with custodial wallet UI is present in AITrader.js but was not tested per request (backend-only). The custodial wallet feature stores encrypted private keys server-side for automated trading execution.
